rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Indefinite integral:** ∫f(x)dx = F(x) + C where F'(x) = f(x). C is the constant of integration.  ·  **Basic integrals:** ∫xⁿdx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1)+C (n≠-1), ∫1/x dx = ln|x|+C, ∫eˣdx = eˣ+C, ∫sin x dx = -cos x+C.  ·  **Integration by substitution:** ∫f(g(x))g'(x)dx = ∫f(u)du where u=g(x).
